(defn- mem-fits [top :i64 end :i64 words :i64] :i64
  (cond (< words 0) 0
        (< end top) 0
        (> end MM-HEAP-END) 0
        :else 1))

;; the error words after an allocation: ok = 1 leaves them, ok = 0 sets E-HEAP-FULL / pos -1 if no error is recorded
(defn- mem-alloc-fin [M0 :vector-i64 ok :i64 newtop :i64 r0 :i64] :vector-i64
  (let [e (vector-at M0 MM-ERR)
        p (vector-at M0 MM-ERR-POS)
        e1 (mem-sel e e E-HEAP-FULL)
        p1 (mem-sel e p -1)]
    (vector-assoc! (vector-assoc! (vector-assoc! (vector-assoc! (vector-assoc! M0 MM-HEAP-TOP newtop) MM-R0 r0) MM-R1 ok)
                                  MM-ERR (mem-sel ok e e1))
                   MM-ERR-POS (mem-sel ok p p1))))

;; R0 = first word of the block (240 on failure), R1 = 1 / 0
(defn- mem-alloc [M0 :vector-i64 words :i64] :vector-i64
  (let [top (vector-at M0 MM-HEAP-TOP)
        end (+ top words)
        ok (mem-fits top end words)]
    (mem-alloc-fin M0 ok (mem-sel ok end top) (mem-sel ok top 240))))

allocatorMeaning: mem-fits returns1 on success, mem-alloc-fin writes ok into MM-R1. R0=base and top advances149610 words; actual success is R1=1/MMERR=0.
